positions.name: MeridianReplacesZypherionAnalytics
positions.frame: what database is the analytics pipeline moving to after the further evaluation, on what capability grounds, and does the migration window change?
positions.why: All seven statements read the revised analytics database choice: the streaming-ingestion gap found in Zypherion (src-1, src-6), the switch to Meridian and its batch-plus-streaming capability (src-2, src-3, src-5), the declared supersession of the earlier Zypherion decision (src-4), and the carried-over Q3 2026 window (src-7). One tension is held, not resolved. The earlier adoption rested on columnar query speed. This revision rests on streaming ingestion, and the speed claim is not disputed. The earlier Zypherion adoption position is not in the consult, so no lineage edge is typed here. The supersession is stated in src-4 and the narrative pass can place it.
